item.title: People line up for ice cream treats every March 1 at this Minnesota Dairy Queen. Why? It’s tradition
item.description: MOORHEAD, Minn. (AP) — It’s still winter in Minnesota, but for the people lined up Sunday in single-digit cold at the Moorhead Dairy Queen, spring is in the air. item.title: Phoenix sets daily heat record for 2nd day in a row, trend could continue as March begins
item.description: Phoenix set a daily heat record for the second day in row on Sunday, the city's temperature surpassing 89 degrees on March 1.

item.title: 353-unit multifamily development coming to Mesa master-planned community
item.description: Construction has begun on 353 multifamily apartment units located within Medina Station, a 60-acre master-planned community in Mesa.

item.title: 2026 Wild West Music Fest in Maricopa to feature hip-hop artist Soulja Boy
item.description: The lineup for the 2026 Wild West Music Fest in Maricopa has been released with hip-hop artist Soulja Boy rounding out the three-day event in late March.

item.title: Traffic restrictions continue on Chandler Boulevard for sewer repair work
item.description: Repaving work will begin Monday on a section of a major Chandler road that has been closed for emergency sewer repairs with one lane in both directions open.
